sentence: half off for anyone with a PR merged into a 1,000-star repo this year; 20% off for any merged PR; 10% off for accounts older than 3 years
readback:
50% off (1000-star PR) if the account has a merged pull request into a repository with at least 1,000 stars (merged this calendar year).
20% off (Any merged PR) if the account has at least 1 merged pull request.
10% off (Old Account) if the GitHub account is at least 1,095 days old.
Only the single best matching tier applies.
